sections.overview: "A bookshelf type speaker system using a special bass reflex system.The low range has a 21.3cm cone type woofer specially designed for bass reflex.It uses a voice coil that thoroughly pursues low distortion. In addition, it uses free edge obtained by special molding of non-woven fabric for the edge, which suppresses distortion and enables low sound reproduction with good rise and elongation.Equipped with a 14.2cm cone type squaker in the middle area.This unit achieves excellent piston motion by reducing the fo and eliminating the generation of split vibration in the audible band.A 9cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range.The enclosure uses a duct with a special shape created through repeated cut-and-try operations."

sections.overview: "A speaker system developed for small Hi-Fi speakers.A 17.5cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.High compliance design is applied in order to obtain acoustic suspension completely, compliance is taken large, and roll edge obtained by special molding of rough cloth on the edge is adopted in order to absorb rolling distortion and amplitude distortion of voice coil.The cone paper uses a non-pressed cone made mainly from pulp, which has excellent physical properties. It has an appropriate internal loss and toughness. In addition, the voice coil uses aluminum to improve the input resistance.A 2.63cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm uses a specially dumped soft dome with a constant impregnation rate.An LC-type network is used in the network section, the best crossover point selected by hearing is taken, and the distortion due to the network is removed by using ferrite core.An independent continuously variable level control has been adopted for the middle and high areas on the side.All 6sides of the enclosure are made of homogen, and the built-in type is adopted for reinforcement.The exterior is designed to make use of the wood grain."
